# MoltenVK 1.4.2 (vendored)

Static `libMoltenVK.a` slices and Vulkan headers from the
[KhronosGroup/MoltenVK v1.4.2 release](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/MoltenVK/releases/tag/v1.4.2),
asset `MoltenVK-all.tar` (SHA-256 `562a15a29bc358446a56a4091c5f7e08f604184187c1d34f712148b61ef17276`),
copied unchanged from `MoltenVK/MoltenVK/static/MoltenVK.xcframework/<slice>/` and `MoltenVK/MoltenVK/include`.

| Slice | Used by |
|---|---|
| `lib/macos-arm64_x86_64` | `desktopApp` (macOS) |
| `lib/ios-arm64` | `shared` iOS device framework |
| `lib/ios-arm64_x86_64-simulator` | `shared` iOS simulator framework |
